description: What has actually been quoted, at what unit price, and how often it was accepted — grouped over the mirrored AbaNinja positions. Answers the question a price list is built from: which line items recur, how many different prices were charged for the same thing, and which of them turned into an accepted quote or a paid invoice. Requires sync_abaninja to have run; the result states how fresh the mirror is and how many documents are still missing their positions, because an analysis over half a stock is worse than none. Read-only, no API call.

min_occurrences.description: Only line items seen at least this often (default 2 — a one-off is not a price list entry).

name: analyze_abaninja_prices
